anchor: Planner behavior is version-specific: it follows the Dynamo 1.x planner design documentation and inspection of the source tree at the commit used for this thesis's simulations (v1.3.0 source build; accessed 2026-07-07).
claim_text: Dynamo planner behavior follows Dynamo 1.x design documentation and source tree at commit used for simulations (v1.3.0 source build, accessed 2026-07-07).

anchor: The methodology is therefore trace-driven discrete-event simulation, the established instrument at this scale in LLM serving
claim_text: The methodology is trace-driven discrete-event simulation.

anchor: The platform prices each pool on the hardware class it targets. The vision pool is an event-driven FIFO of encoder workers costed by aiconfigurator (AIC), NVIDIA's offline planner, over performance data collected for this thesis on an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090
claim_text: The vision pool is priced on an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 using aiconfigurator.

anchor: The language pool is simulated by Dynamo's discrete-event engine under AIC-calibrated H100 timing
claim_text: The language pool is simulated by Dynamo's discrete-event engine under AIC-calibrated H100 timing.

anchor: Correcting the missizing needs more encoder workers and, on the language pool, a tensor-parallel shape change that no replica scaler can perform
claim_text: Fixing encoder undersizing requires adding encoder workers; language pool requires tensor-parallel shape change impossible for replica-only autoscalers
expected_backing: v_grid_static_effective or collector_encoder_fn showing required config changes

anchor: Language-pool GPU-hours bill from instance order, not readiness: the discrete-event mocker integrates the provisioned worker count --- active, starting-up and draining alike --- so the startup ramp and scale-down drain tail are already inside every reported language GPU-hour, and no cold-start surcharge may be added to it.
claim_text: Language pool GPU-hours bill from instance order (not readiness), including startup ramp and scale-down drain tail; no cold-start surcharge added.

anchor: Mixing the two conventions is a second reason, beyond hardware class, the classes are never summed
claim_text: The two hardware classes are never summed due to different billing conventions (order-time vs readiness).

anchor: Each policy produces, per window, a worker schedule for the encoder pool (C(t) workers) and a configuration or replica schedule for the language pool (TP×N H100 workers), graded on the two-pool replay.
claim_text: Each policy produces per-window worker schedule for encoder pool (C(t)) and language pool (TP×N H100 workers), graded on two-pool replay.
